caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a light brown face and hands, black hair styled up and wrapped in a cloth, and red lips. The eyes and eyebrows are drawn with black lines, and the cheeks are slightly blushed. The doll is dressed in a long, light-colored dress decorated with small yellow flowers and trimmed with white lace at the collar, sleeves, and hem. The bodice of the dress is gathered at the waist, giving volume to the skirt. The doll has two different colored feet: the left foot is black, and the right foot is light brown. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or patterns. The composition centers the doll in the frame, displaying the entire figure from head to foot.
title: Doll
